question: In a certain code language, 'MODERATE’ is written as 'FVDVJJVU' and 'NINETEEN' is written as 'OGHXJTPV'. How will 'OCCASION' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'MODERATE’ is written as 'FVDVJJVU',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/323fc3780580351f7d2322f3aaab2cf79690d74c305b2fedb0b45e40f0b83384.png] 

For, 'NINETEEN' is written as 'OGHXJTPV',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7472897efe946e881fe95d500c3513f7e4dfd18f4090160d4cc2d54b1cd5d787.png] 

Similarly, for 'OCCASION'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27bfaf71f58a40f8f1036bf929029b7144ba054d3c7c174ba844c4cdc7a42776.png] 

So, '**OCCASION**' is written as '**OQLWFIJW**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
